data.label: mean NCI SCORE (ExpectedGrowth - PercentGrowth, percentage points) over all combination records of a drug pair x cell line; hit = label > 10 (SynergyFinder convention). No re-thresholding whatever the observed base rate.
data.context: single-agent records (drug 1 at a grid concentration, no drug 2): inhibition = (100 - min(PercentGrowth, 100)) / 100 averaged per drug x line x concentration; mean over concentrations and value at the top concentration
data.costs: dose-point records per experiment (treated as wells; replicate wells per record are not stated by the release); 3 days per round

seen_before_freeze: Design-only census (NSC1, NSC2, CONCINDEX1/2, CELLNAME, SCREENER, PLATE): 3,686,475 records, 2,873,514 combination records, 105 drugs, 5,242 pairs, 60 lines, 305,081 experiments, median 9 records per experiment, screeners 1A/FF/FG; row patterns 2,873,514 combination / 778,227 drug-alone / 34,734 undocumented (excluded).
No PERCENTGROWTH, SCORE, EXPECTEDGROWTH, TESTVALUE, CONTROLVALUE or TZVALUE value has been read.
NCI-ALMANAC is public and has been analysed in the literature (BATCHIE, Wang et al. 2025); this protocol's choices were tuned only on O'Neil 2016.
scenario: one campaign per target cell line (60 units); history = all other lines' measured combinations; context = single-agent responses of every drug in every line
world: WorldConfig defaults (context, feedback, drug similarity, ridge 1.0, shrink 2.0)

primary.H1: Per line, wm_full[certify] hits minus history[exploit] hits; PASS iff the 95% percentile bootstrap interval (10,000 resamples of lines, seed 20261003) of the mean lies above 0.
primary.H2: wm_full certified nominations: mean FDP over 60 lines x 20 audit draws <= 0.2 and its bootstrap upper bound <= 0.25, and yield-bound coverage >= 0.87.
primary.framework: SUPPORTED iff H1 and H2 both PASS; otherwise NOT_SUPPORTED, reported as such.

secondary: S1-S10 as listed in DESIGN.md section 6, computed by verdict.py; estimates with intervals, not confirmatory claims.
execution: python -m research.certified_discovery.confirm (opens the vault once; any failure is logged in run_log.json and reported; a re-run would be a second opening and is recorded as such by the vault log).
not_committed: The working tree is not committed to git at freeze time (commits are the owner's call); integrity rests on protocol/freeze.json digests, the vault log and the day record written before opening.
